entries.original_title: High in the hierarchy: How vertical location and judgments of leaders' power are interrelated
entries.description: Describing a leader as powerful causes participants to place the leader's box at a higher vertical position in an organization chart
entries.citation_sentence: We followed closely the procedure of the original study in Giessner & Schubert (2007).
